text:
The physician may be found liable if they failed to screen for vertebrobasilar insufficiency risk before the treatment. That means not assessing this elderly patient's risk factors, and not doing provocative tests such as a vertebral artery test, before applying cervical rotation and extension with an articulatory (springing) technique. The confusion, nausea, and vertigo after the treatment suggest a vertebral artery injury or vertebrobasilar ischemia. In a patient this age, not obtaining informed consent about this known risk, or not performing the pre-treatment screening, would be a breach of the standard of care.

CONFIDENCE: 70
